# EGO POWER+ MHC1603 — Multi-Head Combo Kit (String Trimmer + Edger)

**Category:** Outdoor Power Equipment (Cordless Multi-Head System)

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Kit contents | PH1420 Power Head, STA1600 16" Carbon Fiber String Trimmer Attachment with POWERLOAD™, EA0820 Carbon Fiber Edger Attachment, 56V 4.0Ah ARC Lithium™ battery, 320W charger, shoulder strap |
| Power head model | PH1420 |
| String trimmer attachment | STA1600 |
| Edger attachment | EA0820 |
| Battery platform | EGO POWER+ 56V ARC Lithium™ (compatible with all EGO 56V batteries) |
| Included battery | 56V 4.0Ah (BA2242T) |
| Included charger | 320W (CH3200) |
| Motor | High-efficiency brushless |
| Speed control | Digital two-speed selector with indicator; variable-speed trigger with lock-off lever |
| Handle | Quick-release adjustable front handle |
| Shaft material | Carbon fiber (Power Head and both attachments), lifetime warranty on shafts |
| Trimmer cutting swath | 16 in |
| Line loading | POWERLOAD™ push-button automatic line winding |
| Edger blade | 8 in |
| Edging depth | Up to 3 in, adjusted via guide-wheel depth knob |
| Runtime (4.0Ah, trimmer) | Up to 45 min |
| Runtime (4.0Ah, edger, low speed) | Up to 75 min |
| Weather resistance | IPX4 |
| Attachment compatibility | Full EGO POWER+ Multi-Head attachment lineup (hedge trimmer, pole saw, extension pole, etc.) |
| Warranty | 5-year limited tool; 3-year limited battery/charger; lifetime on carbon fiber shafts |
| Manual | [Product manual (PDF)](https://egopowerplus.com/mpattachment/file/download/id/3253/) |

## Notable Features

- One Power Head drives the whole EGO Multi-Head attachment system, so this kit is a starting point rather than a fixed two-tool setup.
- POWERLOAD™ line replacement: feed the line, press a button, and the head winds it automatically.
- Carbon fiber shafts on the Power Head and both attachments, covered by a lifetime shaft warranty.
- Digital two-speed selector plus variable-speed trigger and lock-off lever for both control and safety.
- Edger guide wheel with a depth-adjust knob for repeatable edges up to 3 inches deep.
- IPX4 weather-resistant construction.
- Ships with a 320W charger, a step up from the standard EGO charger, plus a 4.0Ah battery and shoulder strap.
- Manufacturer page currently lists the kit as "Coming Soon" with no published price; third-party retailers have listed it around $349.
